review.decision: Ready for formal implementation and mapping
review.notes: Reviewed evidence boundaries and negative oracles. Exploratory working-tree tests ran before this repository ordering gate was discovered; this record does not claim to predate those experiments. This design-only commit precedes the first committed test implementation. Independent frozen-candidate review remains required; no peer/user approval is asserted. Uses synthetic stores, clocks and delivery; no production sessions, permissions, KB or devices. Formal extension: put the bounded sweep in the existing notification pass so a baseline-compatible regression can prove ordinary noted plus no new events still wakes HQ. Existing ingestion test will capture the post-sweep snapshot before read-independence assertions; source ingestion expectations remain unchanged. Fresh self-review before the action-identity fencing amendment: code inspection found that one-shot delivery also needs an immutable per-material-step action ID across responsibility reassessment, including an unknown/refused attempt. The replacement-ID boundary is a refinement of the existing stable-intent case, with original case identity and expectations retained for the repository first-edit history gate. Source adapter boundary reviewed before the formal assertion: only a relay report, never an ask carrying similar structured JSON, may attach a step receipt; the existing exact-receipt case retains its original expected result. CI exposed one fixture missing HOME redirection; retain the real-home panic guard and set a disposable HOME before invoking CLI adapters. Separately reviewed the exact HTTP additive fields against real-handler failure output; only two successful HQ read cases change, with status/auth/cursors/question identity unchanged. Independent review candidates b4d83ac065347bd2a5afb87e29193eac are being checked with isolated regressions before correction: changing a step label must not reset the same action/ref/exact-recipient work; a previously observed native/background driver must keep its durable action reservation after proof expiry. Existing HGD-002 stable-intent/native expectations are retained, with explicit negative boundary assertions and sampled task-cache/build resource records. Read the full independent FAIL report (SHA256 371cd9664291a48fa7b05c63f7833d8c1dabf96d59e278af7e2c85af3d6db157). R3 requires preserving a valid covered-goal claim across unchanged scans while fencing actual premise changes; add its dedicated reviewed case before implementation. Runtime-entry review: test the same workspace callback invoked by serve instead of starting unrelated resource/limits workers. Actual CLI parsing, hook Stop entry and delivery adapter execute; only transport/roster/source adapters are synthetic. This is an isolated component pipeline, not an installed-app or operating-system acceptance claim.

cases.description: Continuing goal debt survives ordinary noted, empty unread, repeated scans and restart; old HQ generations are fenced.
cases.setup: Isolated store, synthetic goal/ordinary report; old and successor assessors; no live sessions.
cases.action: Acknowledge report; bounded scan; reject noted/conflict on uncovered goal; restart, rename and reclaim after lease expiry.
cases.expected: One material goal debt remains, no dispatch, no duplicate debt; stale generation cannot commit.

cases.description: One-shot stable intents separate queued, received/progress and uncertain/refused outcomes.
cases.setup: Isolated store, exact execution association, fake delivery with queue/receipt/panic/refusal.
cases.action: Save plan before drive, invoke drive repeatedly through restart and completion; ingest structured step evidence; change SID/interval.
cases.expected: Only one send per action ID; queued is not work started; exact receipt covers the step; stale SID, ambiguous interval, native/background coverage and unavailable evidence never cause duplicate delivery.

cases.description: User pause/refusal, external conditions and real questions retain their distinct resumption semantics.
cases.setup: Isolated store, explicit sourced holds, fake clock and question/answer receipts.
cases.action: Advance time, attempt unsourced resume, clear a verified cross-channel answer, check next responsibility.
cases.expected: User pause/refusal never expire; external due time requests verification; only a real unanswered question is human debt; verified answer withdraws question and leaves next-step duty.

cases.description: Schema migration, current assessment and latest evidence preserve authority and provenance.
cases.setup: Schema 1/2 synthetic snapshots, more than 128 legacy goals, old assessment150 and new receipt206.
cases.action: Run bounded sweeps; inspect shared projection; attempt body update with revision0 and unversioned observation transition.
cases.expected: Legacy goals become verify-only, no bulk dispatch; 150/206/acceptance181 remain separate; body update requires nonzero revision; relay revision0 cannot transition current state.

cases.description: Periodic and turn-boundary reconciliation use one keyed reminder with current premise checks.
cases.setup: Synthetic source/store/time/wake adapters; Stop marker in task temp; no live queue or HQ.
cases.action: Consume ordinary reports, run reconciliation without new events, mark Stop, cover or pause a goal before queued reminder delivery.
cases.expected: Unfinished goal stays due; source acknowledgement remains independent; stale reminder drops or rerenders; quiet changes presentation only; repeat reminders identify HQ coordination debt.

cases.description: Backup restoration suspends action evidence while preserving user pause/refusal and existing uncertainty.
cases.setup: Isolated backup/store with pending/queued intent attempts and structured native/background proof.
cases.action: Restore records, scan and invoke the same stable action; inspect debt and hold.
cases.expected: No replay after restore, old drive cannot prove current execution, pause/refusal remains effective until explicit sourced resumption.

cases.description: Shared HTTP golden discloses additive next responsibility without changing existing owner/guest or question contracts.
cases.setup: Existing synthetic http-contract.json and real-handler CI output for hq-overview and hq-detail-page; no real HOME/session.
cases.action: Review added next_responsibility fields on the two existing question preview rows and projection on selected detail, then compare the real handler again.
cases.expected: Only additive waiting-user responsibility/provenance fields change; existing body fields, source question identity, status codes, auth, headers and cursors remain exact.

cases.description: A valid covered-goal assessment lease survives an ordinary unchanged periodic scan.
cases.setup: Isolated store with paused and queued goals, synthetic timestamps and verified HQ owners; fake sender only.
cases.action: Claim at150, ScanGoals151, assess152; separately change a coverage premise or expire the lease before assessment.
cases.expected: Unchanged held/queued premises preserve owner/generation/lease and permit current assessment; real premise changes, expiry and old generation reject stale assessments.

cases.description: Exercise the real CLI, Stop entry, serve workspace callback and guarded delivery adapter together in an isolated home.
cases.setup: Disposable HOME/CODEX_HOME, empty tmux socket and disabled tmux executable, synthetic observations/participants and dispatch I/O; no real services or sessions.
cases.action: Enable quiet through CLI; run the Stop entry; invoke the exact workspace callback used by serve; claim/assess/drive via CLI, then retry the same action and complete the matter. Repeat with a human draft and reused SID.
cases.expected: Stop marks a bounded scan; no-event/quiet still leaves HQ debt; actual dispatch guard queues once only for the exact empty composer, refuses draft/identity without input, and the registered premise probe drops the obsolete goal reminder after explicit completion. Background work is joined before restoring test globals.
